topic: Local files placed only by a checkout's remote are quarantined
detail: Security review of SP-023: an agent can make a .git naming any org, so an edit hand-off placed by its remote alone or by a remote stricter than its root, and a repo/owner source under no root, go to quarantine. A genuine org checkout under a personal or public root therefore has its edit hand-offs quarantined until hand-offs carry the editing session's space (SP-029). Registered sources under a root still follow the stricter remote, as session pins do (SP-022). Also consider making SaveSource/RefreshSource for repo/owner kinds operator-only, or limiting repo sources to sources.known_roots.
